title: MergeWright package manifest (mergewright-package.yaml)
description: Experimental: the package API may change between releases (apiVersion says which one a package is written for).

name.description: The package's name: its folder under .mergewright/packages/ and its key under packages: in mergewright.yaml.

apiVersion.description: The package API version the entry is written for.

entry.description: Path of the ES module entry, relative to the package folder (.mjs, .js with type module, or .ts/.mts using erasable syntax only).

exports.description: What the entry's activate() returns, shown before installing (the entry is not run until it is installed).

harnesses.description: Harness ids the package contributes, which roles may name in runs: once the package is installed and enabled.

config.description: JSON Schema of the package's own settings, packages.<name> in mergewright.yaml.

env.description: Environment variables that are not secrets which host.env() may read as well (a tool's home folder, say). Their values are not redacted.

secrets.description: Environment variables whose values are secrets: redacted from tool output and run files, and the only ones host.env() reads. A string names the variable; {config, default} names the setting of packages.<name> that holds the variable's name.
